title: uncertainty attached to a reported score
claim: a quantified uncertainty attached to a reported result.
present: a stderr, CI, ±, variance across runs/seeds, or an explicit statistical qualifier attached to a reported result ("71.3 ± 0.4", "95% CI [69.9, 72.7]", "std across 3 seeds: 0.6")
absent: uncertainty stated for someone else's model in a comparison row but not for the subject model
